stories.title: Example: Champion retains title with late stoppage
stories.summary: An illustrative story showing the shape the news task writes. The summary is always in the task's own words, two to four sentences, with a link to the page it read.
stories.why: Shows why a story matters to a boxer in camp, in one line.

stories.title: Example: Study links short sleep to slower reactions
stories.summary: Another illustrative story. Science items name the study and describe what it found and who it studied, without copying the abstract or inventing any figure the page did not state.
